appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.thisDeviceHelp: Light or dark is a per-device choice; Auto follows the device setting.
appearance.fontHelp: Applies to the whole board, for everyone.
appearance.addGoogleFontHelp: Downloaded once and stored on your server — the board never calls out to Google when someone opens a page, and it keeps working offline.
appearance.tvThemeHelp: How the /tv wall display looks. This is household-wide, not per device.
appearance.tvThemeNoLocation: No location set, so this falls back to a 7am–7pm window. Set a weather location for real sunrise and sunset.
appearance.adminOnly: Ask an admin to change the household font and colors.

about.title: About this board
about.help: If a change you expected isn't here, check this build date — it tells you whether the server was actually rebuilt. The same details are at /api/health.

language.title: Language
language.label: Board language
language.help: Applies to the whole board, for everyone. Dates, times and amounts follow the language you pick.
language.adminOnly: Ask an admin to change the board language.

device.title: This device
device.wallDisplayHelp: Starts the photo slideshow when this device sits idle. Turn on for the kitchen tablet or TV, leave off for phones and laptops.

household.title: Household
household.name: Household name
household.temperatureHelp: How the weather is shown everywhere on the board.
household.mealTimesHelp: When each meal is eaten — cooking blocks on the calendar end at these times.
household.defaultCookHelp: Pre-filled when planning a meal; change it per meal anytime.

profiles.title: Family members
profiles.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from the board? Their history is kept.

apiKeys.title: API access
apiKeys.intro: Let other apps — Home Assistant, scripts — read and update the board.
apiKeys.docsHint: Endpoint reference: {link} (served by this board at {path}).
apiKeys.tokenNotice: Token for “{name}” — save it now, it won't be shown again.
apiKeys.copyFailed: Copy failed — select the token and copy it manually
apiKeys.revokeConfirm: Revoke "{name}"? Anything using this key stops working immediately.

push.title: Notifications
push.unsupported: Push notifications aren't available here. They need a secure (HTTPS) connection and a browser that supports web push.
push.iosInstall: On iPhone and iPad, first add Betts Board to your Home Screen (Share → Add to Home Screen), then enable notifications from the installed app.
push.notifyOnDeviceHelp: Event reminders and chore due-times for your profile arrive as push notifications.
push.blockedHelp: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser's site settings (the lock icon in the address bar), then try again.
push.iosHomeScreen: On iPhone and iPad this only works from the Home Screen app (Share → Add to Home Screen).
push.blocked: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings
push.noDevices: No subscribed devices for your profile yet
push.testSent: Test sent to {sent} of {total} device | Test sent to {sent} of {total} devices
